description: React Native component for the shopping cart screen in a food delivery app, managing cart items, calculating totals, handling navigation, and rendering UI elements.

methods.name: populateFood
methods.description: Prepares and returns detailed food item data from cart item and restaurant data, including title, price, image, options, and addons.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: Calculates total price of cart items, applying discount if applicable.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates total order amount including items and delivery charges.

methods.name: didFocus
methods.description: Sets selected restaurant and minimum order info when data is loaded.

methods.name: emptyCart
methods.description: Renders UI for empty cart state with an option to navigate back to main.

methods.name: loadginScreen
methods.description: Displays loading placeholders while data is being fetched.

methods.name: showAvailablityMessage
methods.description: Shows alert if restaurant is unavailable or closed.

methods.name: onModalOpen
methods.description: Opens a modal dialog via ref.
